text: As I walk through this modern space, I sense the stillness and order of institutional architecture—glass walls, clean lines, a fire extinguisher poised as a silent sentinel of safety. In the next room, vibrant patterns and bold lettering announce innovation and curiosity, inviting me to contemplate meaning and progress. I feel a quiet anticipation, unsettled yet curious, as though I am stepping into a narrative of human inquiry, surrounded by design that suggests both clarity and complexity.
